landing.heroSubtitle: Model rich structured entities, weave multi-dimensional relationships, and explore living knowledge graphs with local-first privacy.
landing.appInstalledToast: Silic is already installed on your device!
landing.installGuideToast: To install Silic PWA, click the Install icon in your browser address bar or menu.
landing.featuresSubtitle: Everything you need to model, connect, analyze, and visualize complex interconnected information.
landing.graphDesc: Physics-based 2D force simulation with customizable node physics, live links, node inspection, and reheat dynamics.
landing.entitiesDesc: Store rich texts, essays, numbers, dates, times, media images, audio, video, files, and color attributes effortlessly.
landing.connectionsDesc: Connect multiple origin nodes to multiple targets with 1-way or 2-way metadata-rich relationships.
landing.queryDesc: Discover shortest relational paths between entities and build nested logical query expressions with mathematical aggregations.
landing.localFirstDesc: Your knowledge stays strictly on your machine in IndexedDB, with instant .silic file backups and optional Google Drive™ sync.
landing.pwaDesc: Install Silic as a standalone desktop or mobile application with zero latency, offline caching, and native speed.
landing.step1Desc: Create customizable templates or individual entities with any combination of data records.
landing.step2Desc: Link entities with 1-way or 2-way semantic relationships and custom attributes.
landing.step3Desc: Navigate the living force graph, search shortest paths, and uncover deep relational insights.
landing.ctaTitle: Ready to organize your thoughts in graph dimensions?
landing.ctaSubtitle: Start building your personal knowledge graph today. Free, private, and local-first.
landing.docsSectionSubtitle: Explore the formal architecture specifications behind the Knowledge Graph Query Engine and Local-First Storage.
landing.docQueryCardDesc: 3-tier decoupled query architecture, Breadth-First Search (BFS) shortest pathfinder, multi-point chaining, and multi-variable boolean expression evaluator.
landing.docStorageCardDesc: 100% Client-side zero-tracking storage with IndexedDB, instant draft caching in LocalStorage, and background non-blocking Web Worker for .silic ZIP package bundling.

guidePage.step1Desc: Standardized schemas of records for reuse.
guidePage.step1Body: A template defines a preset list of records and data types. When a template updates, entities automatically synchronize to the new order.
guidePage.step2Desc: Fill in information values for the entity.
guidePage.step2Body: Choose an existing template or freely add custom unique records to the entity.
guidePage.step3Desc: Connect entities through the relationships tab.
